examples.text: seyyathā'pi brāhmaṇa kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabb'ākāraparipūro cā'ti.
eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.
sammaddasā vedaguno, samma'd'aññāya paṇḍitā, abhibhuyya mārasaṃyogaṃ, na gacchanti punabbhavan'ti.
ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā'ti, satam'pi mayaṃ, bho gotama, gaṇāpema, bhiyyo'pi gaṇāpema.

pañcasīle samādāya, dasakammapathe tato, samādāya pavattento, parisaṃ sikkhāpayissati.

32011.meaningLit: discourse on ten courses of action

32013.meaning1: worth ten silver coins; ten silver coins in value

32016.meaning1: endowed with ten factors; having ten parts

examples.text: pajjotakaro ativijjha, sabbaṭṭhitīnaṃ atikkamam'addasa, ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi das'addhānaṃ.

32020.meaning1: in ten ways; into ten; into ten pieces

examples.text: so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya.
anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadatī'ti. so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya.

32023.grammar: card, x dat pl of dasa

examples.text: so gāmaṃ pavisitvā, ammatātā, svātanāya mayā buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito, tumhe yattakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dātuṃ sakkhissatha, tattakānaṃ dānaṃ dethā'ti ārocetvā vicaranto attano attano balaṃ sallakkhetvā mayaṃ dasannaṃ dassāma, mayaṃ vīsatiyā, mayaṃ satassa, mayaṃ pañcasatānan'ti vutte sabbesaṃ vacanaṃ ādito paṭṭhāya paṇṇe āropesi.

32024.grammar: card, x gen pl of dasa

examples.text: yo daṇḍena adaṇḍesu, appaduṭṭhesu dussati, dasannam'aññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, khippam'eva nigacchati.

32033.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: iti h'etaṃ vijānāma, navamo so parābhavo, dasamaṃ bhagavā brūhi, kiṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

32036.commentary: (MNa) dasamo'ti so hi jātigottavasena c'eva sārappattakulagaṇanāya ca dasame ṭhāne gaṇīyati, ten'assa dasamotv'eva nāmaṃ jātaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake. tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

32038.meaning1: tenth training rule requiring communal rehabilitation

examples.text: imissā ca, bhikkhave, mahāpathaviyā pahūtarattaratanāya [pahūtasattaratanāya tikanipāte mahāvagge dasamasuttaṭīkāyaṃ dassitapāḷiyā sameti] mātāpitaro issar'ādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya, na tv'eva, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti paṭikataṃ vā.

32043.meaning2: (what is) based on ten items; (a statement or exposition) concerned with ten items

tassa evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā dasasahassassa brahmuno sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti. so taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.

ayañ'ca dasasahassilokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi, appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamma devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvan'ti.

32057.meaning1: who follows ten precepts; who adheres to ten training rules

32064.meaning2: of ten years' standing; who has been ordained for ten years

32066.meaning1: living for ten thousand years; with a lifespan of ten thousand years

32067.meaning1: living for ten years; with a lifespan of ten years

32068.meaning1: time of having a lifespan of ten years

32071.meaning2: following the ten ways of living

32072.commentary: (APAa) disā dasavidhā loke'ti cakkavāḷaloke dasavidhā dasakoṭṭhāsā disā honti

examples.text: dve khandhā taññ'eva siyaṃ, adhivacanañ'ca hetunā, sakkāyena duve vuttā, assādaviññāṇakena ca, ete dasavidhā vuttā, hoti bhikkhu pucchāyā'ti.
disā dasavidhā loke, yāyato n'atthi antakaṃ, tasmiñ'ca disābhāgamhi, buddhakhettā asaṅkhiyā.

32073.meaning1: what are called the ten blemishes of insight

32075.meaning1: with ten factors; with ten attributes

dasah'aṅgehi sampannā, mahānāgā samāhitā, ete kho seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, taṇhā tesaṃ na vijjati.
imehi kho, brāhmaṇa, purohito brāhmaṇo rañño mahāvijitassa pubb'eva yaññā dasah'ākārehi paṭiggāhakesu vippaṭisāraṃ paṭivinesi.
tato paraṃ, pañcah'ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā sattah'ākārehi odhisopharaṇā dasah'ākārehi disāpharaṇā'ti ayaṃ vikubbanā, sukhaṃ supatī'ti-ādayo ānisaṃsā ca mettāyaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbā'ti.

32084.meaning1: ten sense fields; five sense fields and their respective objects

32085.commentary: (SNa) dasārahānan'ti evaṃnāmakānaṃ khattiyānaṃ. te kira satato dasabhāgaṃ gaṇhiṃsu, tasmā dasārahā'ti paññāyiṃsu.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ ānako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi. tassa dasārahā ānake ghaṭite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu. ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi.

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine das'āhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: das'āh'ānatikkante vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. das'āh'ānatikkante anatikkantasaññī, anāpatti.

32093.meaning1: for ten days coming up to; ten days before

examples.text: das'āh'ānāgataṃ kattika-temāsika-puṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno pan'eva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ

so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakena'pi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

32096.commentary: (PYt) dasikasutt'ādin'ti ettha dasā'ti vatthass'āvayavo. so hi diyyati avakhaṇḍīyatī'ti dasā'ti vuccati, tassaṃ dasāyaṃ pavattaṃ dasikaṃ, tam'eva suttaṃ dasikasuttaṃ. ādisaddena vakkhamānaṃ dukkantitasutt'ādiṃ saṅgaṇhātī'ti.

examples.text: nānappakārakaṃ nāma cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārā, antamaso cuṇṇapiṇḍo'pi dantakaṭṭham'pi dasikasuttam'pi.

32097.commentary: (DNa) das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmī'ti-ādim'āha. tattha dasadhā mātikaṃ ṭhapetvā vibhatto'ti das'uttaro, ekakato paṭṭhāya yāva dasakā gato'ti'pi das'uttaro, ek'ekasmiṃ pabbe dasa dasa pañhā visesitā'ti'pi das'uttaro, taṃ das'uttaraṃ.

examples.text: das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.

dasuttarasatasuttanta + ā
32098.commentary: (VINt) das'uttarasatasutt'antā'ti etthā'pi dvādas'uttarasatasutt'antā'ti pāṭhena bhavitabbaṃ. tathā hi ekakanipāte tāva sattavīsati suttāni, dukanipāte dvāvīsati, tikanipāte paññāsa, catukkanipāte terasā'ti dvādas'uttarasata-sutt'antān'eva itivuttakapāḷiyaṃ āgatāni.

examples.text: somanassa-ñāṇamayika-gāthā-paṭisaṃyuttā dv'āsīti sutt'antā udānan'ti veditabbaṃ. vuttañ'h'etaṃ bhagavatā'tiādinayappavattā das'uttarasatasutt'antā itivuttakan'ti veditabbaṃ. apaṇṇakajātak'ādīni paññās'ādhikāni pañca jātakasatāni jātakan'ti veditabbaṃ.

32099.meaningLit: discourse increasing (from one) up to ten
